name: artisya-yan
description: Artisya Yan?! - an offline follow-back checker for Instagram that works from your own data export and keeps your whitelist in a spreadsheet.
author: Niño D. Agustin

scripts.build-dev: npm run build && webpack serve --mode development
scripts.build-prod: npm run build && webpack serve --mode production
scripts.build: npm run webpack-build && npm run update-index && npm run build-offline
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/tests/scan-resilience.test.js test-dist/tests/whitelist-compat.test.js test-dist/tests/offline.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm audit --omit=dev
